subject: Kickoff: Admin Keying & Access Sprint for AtlasHealth
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Katie Summers <katie@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Admin Keying & Access Sprint for AtlasHealth

Hi Katie —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. As discussed, we'll run a short access sprint to get AtlasHealth's first workspace seeded and API keys provisioned. Proposed goals for this sprint (day-0 to day-3):

- Deliverables:
  - Create admin project and seed two admin users (team leads)
  - Provision initial API keys and a service account for ingestion
  - Apply role templates for dev/test/ops and document role bindings
  - Verify network/VPC access and KMS integration checklist items

- Owners:
  - Naomi (CS): coordination, kickoff, mutual-action-plan follow-up
  - Connor (Infra CS): API key provisioning, rotation guidance, sample scripts
  - Monica (Implementation): admin invites, role seeding, onboarding walkthrough

As next steps, can you confirm: 1) a 60–90m kickoff slot tomorrow 2026-09-05 between 10–12 PT or 2–4 PT, and 2) who from your side should receive admin invites (name + email)?

I'm attaching the Atlas-specific onboarding checklist and a short mutual action tracker to this thread. I'll create a HubSpot task tied to the deal (DEAL-8791-ATLAS) and share the Drive folder once we confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running quickly.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: atlas_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf stub), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks — that plan looks good. We'd like to split the kickoff into two short blocks if possible:

1) Security & compliance Q/A (30m) — I'll bring our info-security lead and procurement (threaded here)
2) Admin seeding & keys (45–60m) — product/engineering will join for this session

Tomorrow 2026-09-05 at 10:30 PT works for us for the security session; can we do the admin session at 14:00 PT? If not, we can move both to Friday.

Also, procurement asked for a quick pointer to SOC2 evidence and data retention terms before kickoff — do you have a single link or packet you can share?

Attendees to seed as admins:
- Katie Summers <katie@atlashealth.com>
- Martin Li <martin.li@atlashealth.com>
